Complete each second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first. Use the given word unchanged and write 3 to 6 words, including that word. Write only the missing words.

Example: They decided not to accept the offer. (AGAINST) They ____ the offer. Answer: decided against accepting

1. The editor told us not to publish the quotation before checking it.
Keyword: AGAINST
The editor warned ____ the quotation before checking it.

2. The reporter only discovered the error after the article had appeared.
Keyword: UNTIL
It was ____ that the reporter discovered the error.

3. The interview was cancelled because the guest became ill.
Keyword: ACCOUNT
The interview was cancelled ____ the guest becoming ill.

4. I am certain that Maya did not invent the figures.
Keyword: CANNOT
Maya ____ the figures.

5. The readers would rather see the full statement than a short extract.
Keyword: PREFERENCE
The readers have ____ over a short extract.

6. The editor made it clear that the draft was not ready for publication.
Keyword: DOUBT
The editor left us ____ the draft was not ready for publication.

questions.prompt:
1. The editor told us not to publish the quotation before checking it.
Keyword: AGAINST.
The editor warned ____ the quotation before checking it.
Use 3 to 6 words, including AGAINST unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: warn somebody against doing为告诫不要，against后不接不定式。

questions.prompt:
2. The reporter only discovered the error after the article had appeared.
Keyword: UNTIL.
It was ____ that the reporter discovered the error.
Use 3 to 6 words, including UNTIL unchanged. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: not until the article had appeared

rejectedAnswers: not until had the article appeared

questions.explanation: not until强调时间，两种过去表达均可；嵌入时间从句内部不倒装。

questions.prompt:
3. The interview was cancelled because the guest became ill.
Keyword: ACCOUNT.
The interview was cancelled ____ the guest becoming ill.
Use 3 to 6 words, including ACCOUNT unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: on account of表示原因，on the account for非固定搭配。

questions.prompt:
4. I am certain that Maya did not invent the figures.
Keyword: CANNOT.
Maya ____ the figures.
Use 3 to 6 words, including CANNOT unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: cannot have done为对过去不可能性的肯定推断；cannot had不合情态原形。

questions.prompt:
5. The readers would rather see the full statement than a short extract.
Keyword: PREFERENCE.
The readers have ____ over a short extract.
Use 3 to 6 words, including PREFERENCE unchanged. Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: a preference for the full statement

rejectedAnswers: a preference to the full statement

questions.explanation: have a preference for X over Y保持偏好比较；preference to X不是此结构。

questions.prompt:
6. The editor made it clear that the draft was not ready for publication.
Keyword: DOUBT.
The editor left us ____ the draft was not ready for publication.
Use 3 to 6 words, including DOUBT unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: leave somebody in no doubt/without any doubt that表清楚说明，不是in a doubt。

1. Nora did not want to take responsibility for organising the whole event.
Keyword: RESPONSIBILITY.
Nora was reluctant ____ organising the whole event.
Use 3 to 6 words, including RESPONSIBILITY unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: take/accept/assume responsibility for均表示承担，不能of替代for。

questions.prompt:
2. We would have finished sooner if more volunteers had arrived.
Keyword: WOULD.
Had more volunteers arrived, we ____ sooner.
Use 3 to 6 words, including WOULD unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: 过去未实现条件Had arrived对应would have finished，不用一般现在将来结果。

questions.prompt:
3. The coordinator insisted that every box should carry a destination label.
Keyword: ON.
The coordinator insisted ____ a destination label.
Use 3 to 6 words, including ON unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: insist on+名词逻辑主语+doing，carry裸原形不合。

questions.prompt:
4. The delivery was delayed, but this did not discourage the volunteers.
Keyword: EFFECT.
The delay did not ____ the volunteers.
Use 3 to 6 words, including EFFECT unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: have an effect on作用于，discouraging保留消极影响的否定；to不能代on。

questions.prompt:
5. The organiser did not know that the same job had been assigned twice.
Keyword: UNAWARE.
The organiser was ____ had been assigned twice.
Use 3 to 6 words, including UNAWARE unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: unaware (that)+从句，that可省；unaware of不能直接连had been谓语。

questions.prompt:
6. The volunteers were told that wearing closed shoes was compulsory.
Keyword: REQUIRED.
The volunteers were ____ closed shoes.
Use 3 to 6 words, including REQUIRED unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: be required to do为必须，required后不直接接wearing表达相同义。

questions.prompt:
6. The critic accused the translator of leaving out an important phrase.

Use 3 to 6 words, including OMITTED unchanged. Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: translator作删去者，the translator had omitted为主动过去完成；had been omitted改变主语角色。

Only after the permit had arrived ____ work.

questions.prompt:
2. Replacing every window would cost more than we can afford.
Keyword: COST.
We cannot afford ____ every window.
Use 3 to 6 words, including COST unchanged. Write only the missing words.

5. The contractor is said to have underestimated the work involved.

It is ____ the work involved.

The sensor ____ by the hail.

questions.prompt:

Use 3 to 6 words, including DROP unchanged. Write only the missing words.
